answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 148383 Country: India Title: Can we make name plate by wall in our father's grave? Question: Can we make name plate by wall in our father's grave? Answer ID: 148383 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 550/567/M=5/1438) It is forbidden to make the grave concrete, as well as it is makrooh to install headstone on the grave without a need. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
